## Global options

```text
  -v, --verbose   Enable verbose logging
```

## Basic commands

(cli-status)=

### `status`

Show the status of the inference snap

```shell
<inference-snap> status
```

```text
      --format string         output format (json, yaml) (default "yaml")
      --wait-for-components   wait for engine components to be installed before reporting status
```

(cli-chat)=

### `chat`

Chat with the server via its OpenAI API.
This CLI supports text-based prompting only.

```shell
<inference-snap> chat
```

(cli-webui)=

### `webui`

Open the snap's builtin web user interface in the default browser

```shell
<inference-snap> webui
```

## Configuration commands

(cli-get)=

### `get`

Print one or more configurations

```shell
<inference-snap> get [<key>]
```

(cli-set)=

### `set`

Set a configuration

```shell
<inference-snap> set <key=value>...
```

```text
      --assume-yes   assume yes for all prompts
      --no-restart   do not restart the snap after setting the configuration
```

(cli-unset)=

### `unset`

Unset a user configuration, reverting to package or engine default. If no default exists for the key, it will be removed entirely.

```shell
<inference-snap> unset <key>
```

```text
      --assume-yes   assume yes for all prompts
      --no-restart   do not restart the snap after setting the configuration
```

## Management commands

(cli-engines)=

### `engines`

List available engines

```shell
<inference-snap> engines
```

```text
      --format string   output format (table, json) (default "table")
```

(cli-engine)=

### `engine`

Print information about the active engine, or the specified engine

```shell
<inference-snap> engine [<engine>]
```

```text
      --format string   output format (json, yaml) (default "yaml")
```

(cli-use-engine)=

### `use-engine`

Select an engine

```shell
<inference-snap> use-engine [<engine>]
```

```text
      --assume-yes        assume yes for all prompts
      --auto              automatically select a compatible engine
      --components        consider pre-installed components (requires --auto)
      --fallback string   fallback engine to use when hardware information is unavailable (requires --auto or --fix)
      --fix               fix issues with the currently active engine
      --no-restart        do not restart the snap after changing engine
```

(cli-models)=

### `models`

List available models

```shell
<inference-snap> models
```

```text
      --all             list all models, including those not supported by the active engine
      --format string   output format (table, json) (default "table")
```

(cli-model)=

### `model`

Print information about the active model, or the specified model

```shell
<inference-snap> model [<model>]
```

```text
      --format string   output format (json, yaml) (default "yaml")
```

(cli-use-model)=

### `use-model`

Select a model

```shell
<inference-snap> use-model [<model>]
```

```text
      --assume-yes   assume yes for all prompts
      --no-restart   do not restart the snap after changing model
```

```text
      --format string   output format (json, yaml) (default "yaml")
```

(cli-prune-cache)=

### `prune-cache`

Remove cached data

```shell
<inference-snap> prune-cache
```

```text
      --engine string   Remove caches of an engine
```

      --format string   output format (json, yaml) (default "yaml")
